title: Polymarket Elections and Politics Tracker
description: Tracks all election and politics-related prediction markets. Captures presidential races, congressional outcomes, policy predictions, and political events. Polymarket is widely cited as a leading indicator for political outcomes - this script lets you build your own historical dataset.
code:
import pandas as pd
import requests
import json
import re
from datetime import datetime, timezone

BASE = 'https://gamma-api.polymarket.com'
LIMIT = 100
MAX_PAGES = 5

POLITICS_KEYWORDS = re.compile(
    r'\b(election|president|governor|senator|congress|parliament|'
    r'democrat|republican|gop|dnc|rnc|primary|caucus|ballot|vote|voter|'
    r'nominee|candidat|inaugurat|impeach|cabinet|supreme.court|scotus|'
    r'legislation|bill|law|executive.order|veto|filibuster|'
    r'poll|approval.rating|favorability|swing.state|electoral|'
    r'trump|biden|desantis|harris|newsom|haley|pence|obama|'
    r'party|bipartisan|midterm|runoff|recount|certif)\b',
    re.IGNORECASE
)

POLITICS_TAGS = {'politics', 'elections', 'us-politics', 'us-elections',
                  'government', 'policy', 'regulation', 'congress',
                  'white-house', 'supreme-court', 'democrat', 'republican'}

rows = []
for page in range(MAX_PAGES):
    offset = page * LIMIT
    resp = requests.get(
        f'{BASE}/markets',
        params={'limit': LIMIT, 'offset': offset, 'active': 'true', 'closed': 'false'},
        timeout=30,
    )
    resp.raise_for_status()
    markets = resp.json()
    if not markets:
        break
    for m in markets:
        question = m.get('question', '')
        desc = m.get('description', '')
        category = (m.get('category', '') or '').lower()
        tags_raw = m.get('tags', [])
        if isinstance(tags_raw, str):
            tags_raw = json.loads(tags_raw)
        tag_labels = []
        tag_slugs = set()
        for t in (tags_raw or []):
            if isinstance(t, dict):
                label = t.get('label', t.get('slug', ''))
                tag_labels.append(label)
                tag_slugs.add(label.lower())
                if t.get('slug'):
                    tag_slugs.add(t['slug'].lower())
            else:
                tag_labels.append(str(t))
                tag_slugs.add(str(t).lower())
        is_politics = bool(POLITICS_KEYWORDS.search(question) or POLITICS_KEYWORDS.search(desc))
        is_politics = is_politics or bool(tag_slugs.intersection(POLITICS_TAGS))
        is_politics = is_politics or 'politic' in category or 'election' in category
        if not is_politics:
            continue
        prices = m.get('outcomePrices', '[]')
        if isinstance(prices, str):
            prices = json.loads(prices)
        yes_price = float(prices[0]) if prices else None
        no_price = float(prices[1]) if len(prices) > 1 else None
        rows.append({
            'market_id': m.get('id', ''),
            'question': question,
            'slug': m.get('slug', ''),
            'yes_price': yes_price,
            'no_price': no_price,
            'volume': float(m.get('volume', 0) or 0),
            'liquidity': float(m.get('liquidity', 0) or 0),
            'category': m.get('category', ''),
            'tags': ','.join(tag_labels),
            'end_date': m.get('endDate', ''),
            'condition_id': m.get('conditionId', ''),
            '_epoch': int(datetime.now(timezone.utc).timestamp()),
        })

df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
df = df.sort_values('volume', ascending=False).reset_index(drop=True)
GENERATE_RESULTS(df)
